definitions.explanation: To receive something temporarily with the intention of returning it.
To pay to use something temporarily, like an apartment or car.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}を{借|か}りてもいいですか？
{図書館|としょかん}で{本|ほん}を{借|か}りました。
examples.english: I borrowed a book from the library.
examples.notes: で marks where you borrow from

examples.japanese: アパートを{借|か}りています。
{友達|ともだち}からお{金|かね}を{借|か}りました。
examples.english: I borrowed money from a friend.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}を{借|か}りたいのですが。
examples.english: I'd like to rent a car.

examples.japanese: {傘|かさ}を{借|か}りてもいいですか。
{駅|えき}の{近|ちか}くに{部屋|へや}を{借|か}りました。
examples.english: I rented a room near the station.

examples.japanese: {辞書|じしょ}を{借|か}りて、{調|しら}べました。
examples.english: I borrowed a dictionary and looked it up.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}のために{自転車|じてんしゃ}を{借|か}りました。
examples.english: I rented a bicycle for the trip.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}から{本|ほん}を{借|か}りて、{一週間|いっしゅうかん}で{読|よ}みました。
examples.english: I borrowed a book from my teacher and read it in one week.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{近|ちか}くにマンションを{借|か}りているので、{通勤|つうきん}が{楽|らく}です。
examples.english: I'm renting an apartment near my company, so my commute is easy.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xに/からYを{借|か}りる (borrow Y from X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {借|か}りている = 'have borrowed (still have it)' or 'am renting.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{本|ほん}を{借|か}りる (borrow a book)
・{図書館|としょかん}で{借|か}りる (borrow from the library)
・アパートを{借|か}りる (rent an apartment)
・{借|か}りてもいい？ (may I borrow?)

Opposite: {貸|か}す (to lend).
